name: Blood Lust
source:
Welcome to the party where the drinks flow… and the bodies pile up. Talk, flirt, offend – but remember: someone might not survive your curiosity.

[From [url=https://emmymkai.itch.io/blood-lust]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到酒水四溢的派对……尸体堆积如山。交谈、调情、冒犯——但请记住：某人可能无法承受你的好奇心。

[来自[url=https://emmymkai.itch.io/blood-lust]Itch.io[/url]]
